expected.summary: The call returns at once with the long job (exit 0, data.result.job with its poll command); with the project packaged and closed in Designer, the job brings the packaged schematic into the open board (J1, C1, R1, D1, unplaced) and reads back the forward-annotation status in_synch. The live record checks the job's final receipt with job get separately.

The call returns at once with the long job (exit 0, data.result.job with its poll command); the board is in sync already: the preview lists no change, and the job ends completed with outcome in_synch and change not_applied. The live record checks the job's final receipt with job get separately.
The session has no such board open.
A Designer and a Layout are both running (the usual state once the board exists), and the call names neither --session nor --doc: E_AMBIGUOUS lists both instances with their documents.
An earlier forward-annotation job on this board has ended, and no job get or job list has read its end yet, so its operation still locks the board's forward annotation: E_CONFLICT target_locked.
Run under a scope file that does not cover the target (the board); nothing is previewed to the application's files or sent.

While a forward-annotation run or pcb export job of this tool runs in Layout, the session reports busy or unresponsive. Only --session is given: Layout does not say which board it has open while it does not answer, and a --doc it cannot match would be E_NOT_FOUND.

A person leaves a modal dialog open in Layout before the call, such as Setup > Setup Parameters or Help > About. Layout stops answering COM, the session is reported blocked with the dialog's title; E_HUMAN_REQUIRED with action dismiss_dialog and a resume command. Only --session is given, since a blocked Layout does not say which board it has open.
The call returns the job (exit 0); Layout lost during ForwardAnnotate ends the job with change unknown, which job get reports as ok false with E_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, settled with operation resolve.

rows.unrunnable: The COM connection to Layout cannot be cut on demand at the moment of a call; driver tests D06 and D21 cover how the runtime handles a lost connection.

expected.summary: The call returns at once with the long job (exit 0, data.result.job with its poll command); the board holds unsaved changes of this tool (a pcb update not yet saved); the job runs as usual and saves nothing. The live record checks the job's final receipt with job get separately.

The call returns at once with the long job (exit 0, data.result.job with its poll command); after the job has ended and before job get, packager run packages the project once more (Designer closed), so Layout reports forward annotation required again; the read-back job get runs finds status required, not in_synch, and job get reports ok false with E_VERIFY_FAILED. The live record checks the job's final receipt with job get separately.
